```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    subtitle = "2016-2020 American Community Survey",
    fill = "Median Income"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
